patches.content:
diff --git a/dist/images/Dockerfile.ubuntu.nv b/dist/images/Dockerfile.ubuntu.nv
--- a/dist/images/Dockerfile.ubuntu.nv
+++ b/dist/images/Dockerfile.ubuntu.nv
@@ -23,4 +23,5 @@ ARG TARGETARCH
 # Each package source is selected independently. Only Artifactory needs a secret.
 COPY dist/images/install-ovn-ovs.sh /tmp/install-ovn-ovs.sh
 RUN --mount=type=secret,id=artifactory_cert \
+    --mount=type=bind,source=dist/images/nvkr-apt-get,target=/usr/local/bin/apt-get \
     sh /tmp/install-ovn-ovs.sh && rm /tmp/install-ovn-ovs.sh
@@ -28,5 +29,6 @@
 COPY dist/images/install-kubectl.sh /tmp/install-kubectl.sh
-RUN DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update \
+RUN --mount=type=bind,source=dist/images/nvkr-apt-get,target=/usr/local/bin/apt-get \
+    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gpg netcat-traditional net-tools nftables iptables iproute2 iputils-arping ncat dnsutils socat \
 && sh /tmp/install-kubectl.sh && rm /tmp/install-kubectl.sh \
 && apt-get autoremove -y \
diff --git a/dist/images/nvkr-apt-get b/dist/images/nvkr-apt-get
new file mode 100755
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dist/images/nvkr-apt-get
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+set -eu
+
+# Build-only bind mount: keep the upstream repositories, versions and trust checks.
+# Acquire retries cover transient fetches; whole-command retries also cover HTTP
+# 520, which APT does not classify as transient. Never accept partial index updates.
+attempt=1
+while :; do
+    if /usr/bin/apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 \
+        -o Acquire::http::Timeout=30 -o Acquire::https::Timeout=30 \
+        -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any "$@"; then
+        exit 0
+    else
+        status=$?
+    fi
+    if [ "$attempt" -ge 3 ]; then
+        exit "$status"
+    fi
+    delay=$((attempt * 5))
+    printf 'apt-get failed (exit %s); retry %s/3 in %ss\n' "$status" "$((attempt + 1))" "$delay" >&2
+    sleep "$delay"
+    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
+done
